Coach praises the pressing after his first win

By Jo Martin · 2 October 2026

The new head coach did not hide his delight after the two-nil win over the league leaders, his first since taking charge in the summer. "I liked everything: the start, the middle of the game, the end," he said, singling out the work his side did without the ball.

He called the counter-press "phenomenal" and said the performance would become a reference for the rest of his tenure. "We will use it to show the players how it is done," he explained, before reserving special praise for the young playmaker, whose display he described as "really excellent".

The side travels north on Sunday to face a team that beat them one-nil in the reverse fixture, and the coach expects a very different game against a deeper defensive block.
